notes.title: Holidays/Quests Update
notes.notes:
Hello again, nomads and wanderers. We've been hard at work on some new systems and a bunch of content, and we're excited to share it with you!

Quests
The quests system is now complete, and some quests have been created to give the player some direction.

Main Quests direct you towards the most important goals in the game, such as capturing territories and building your Sanctuary
Side Quests are picked up from NPCs or found randomly around the city, they are mostly bonus rewards but also teach you some of the lore of the game world
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38674727/afea2501a5c0b504d3b614be5dce046a0307df88.png

Holidays
In each of the 4 seasons, there is a holiday (and 2 in Autumn).

Spring contains Easter, and some Easter/Spring themed rewards
Summer has Freedom day, and fireworks
Autumn has Thanksgiving, and Halloween, with a quest and themed rewards for each
Winter has Christmas, and a quest full of Yuletide cheer
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38674727/c2f0f99f246685efaffc63621c83aa4d9b3337cd.png

Temperature System Overhaul
We've tweaked and fixed a bunch of things with the Temperature system.

Negative insulation now works correctly, you will get colder faster and hotter slower.
More significant penalties for extreme hot and cold temperatures, up to and including character death


Redone City Randomizer
Our coder is hard at work recreating the city randomizer from the ground up.
As of now, you'll probably notice the streets are always the same, although the lots are random with respect to themselves. The new system will have a completely random city generated each new game, including streets, point of interest locations, district types (residential or city), etc.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38674727/04b75baf12cfb67b752c1fe48f4c2fb9782e2615.png

notes.title: Weather/Seasons Update
notes.notes:
Welcome back, fellow vagrants! 
It's been a while since you've heard from us, but we've been hard at work preparing the newest update for Urban Survival; the Weather and Seasons update. You'll notice some pretty significant changes the next time you log in after the update.

Calendar
The game now hosts a calendar, visible on your map.

The game will advance through the days at midnight, obviously
Each day new trash containers will appear through out the city, making your trash supply endless
Each season has 7 days
Each season will contain a holiday in a future update

Seasons and Weather
Spring, Summer, Autumn, and Winter all have their own unique weather and challenges.

In the Spring you will find more rain, and sometimes thunderstorms
In the Summer there will be less rain and wind, and more heat, possibly heatwaves
Autumn is getting colder, a warning for what's to come. As well as hailstorms
Winter is the coldest time of year, so bundle up. Possible blizzards

Heat, Insulation, and Wetness
Along with Armor, which is now displayed in the equipment screen, you will also find an Insulation value

A higher insulation value will stop your heat from falling faster
A lower insulation value (down even into negatives) will stop your heat from rising faster, keeping you cool in those hotter days
Standing in the rain or snow will cause your equipment to get wet, reducing your effective insulation by up to 50%

Holidays
Holidays are no longer real time events, but they will take place at a certain point in the calendar year.

Each season will have a unique holiday, some of them two
Spring will see Easter, Summer hosts a solstice festival, Autumn is home to Thanksgiving and Halloween, and of course Winter will contain the existing Christmas event
These holidays will not be in the update coming up, quite yet, but will follow shortly after with their own update, adding the missing events

notes.title: Christmas -> Spring Update
notes.notes:
Since the integrated Calendar and Seasons system is not yet in place, we have removed the Christmas content for the time being.

Coming Soon:
This content will be available again fairly soon, as we move into a dynamic seasons and date system. [olist]
Each game file will progress through the calendar year, starting in Spring and moving through Winter as you play.
Each season will bring new challenges, as the Temperature and Weather systems will also be included in this update.
Each Season will be divided into a 7 day Calendar, and Seasonal events like Halloween and Christmas will be active during the appropriate season in game. 
(For example, Halloween will be active during the last 2 days of Autumn.)
[/olist]

notes.title: Thanksgiving Patch
notes.notes:
The latest update fixes a few problems with Thanksgiving content, and adds some more content to the game.

-Each city now contains 4 Bus Stops for quick travel
-Reduced Dumpster spawn rate
-Fixed a number of animation issues involving eating or drinking items
-Fixed missing item thumbnails
-Lowered the cost of the Feather Hat

-All ranged items now do consistent damage across all enemy types
-Increased XP gained from cooking meals

notes.title: Navigation Patch
notes.notes:
We will be updating the game very soon with a patch that should optimize Character navigation. The game used to try to generate navigation only once. This would often result in an inaccurate nav mesh after the world had finished randomizing (or applying the randomized world from any existing game file), and especially after placing new buildings.

This would sometimes result in characters getting stuck in certain places, which could cause nearly irreparable damage to save files if the game data was saved at bad times.

However, in the next version, the navigation mesh will be updated constantly, but only within loading zones around the player. Allies who are sent home (by interacting with them while they are in your party), will try to walk towards home for a while, but will teleport after a short period.
In the older versions, characters sent home would actually try to path all the way back to your sanctuary, which had very mixed results. Forcing them to teleport after a short period should mitigate save file issues, and is necessary now that Navigation only generates within the load distance from the Player.

notes.title: Halloween Patch
notes.notes:
-Added 2 new achievements for the Halloween Event
-Fixed a glitch which gave the wrong achievements for Master Chef and Master Crafter. If you've earned Master Crafter, and received Master Chef, loading your file should give you the correct achievement.
-Fixed a number of animation issues with Enemy and Ally characters
-Fixed a glitch which applied the wrong textures to masks on Ally characters
-Fixed a glitch which made the Neutral characters appear as Enemies to Ally characters
-Ally character's weapons will now properly apply Bleed/Piercing effects

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
Very quick patch here to fix an issue with the Storage building.
Accessing this building hard locked your game as the close button was being hidden by other UI elements. This has now been fixed, and the Storage building should work as intended.

notes.title: Small Patch 2
notes.notes:
Uploading a patch here to fix a few of the first couple bugs we've noticed. Don't hesitate to let us know about any bugs you find, that way we can build a comprehensive fix list faster.
This patch will fix the following:

- Bottles breaking immediately after throwing (player)
- Decreased chance for certain weapons to knock down opponents when power attacking
- Toned down the trip out effects
- Added some clarifying text to Signy tutorial
- Fixed some item thumbnails not loading properly
- Fixed some other UI errors (buttons, mostly)
- Fixed a possible error obtaining the "17 accomplishments" reward

notes.title: Small patch
notes.notes:
Just uploaded a patch which should fix an achievement glitch.

If you'd completed any of the following:
-Scrapper
-Our First Dollar
-Spore King
-Blood Donation
-Blood Bath

But did not get the achievement in game, or posted to Steam, simply download the update, load up your file, and earn another point towards the achievement, and it should unlock.
For example, if you have over $1.00 in game, but did not get Our First Dollar, loading your file and earning another cent should unlock the Achievement after updating.
